# Vendor JavaScript libraries

All libraries below are loaded by individual tool pages. Every library is
MIT licensed (no GPL code anywhere in this project).

| File | Library & version | License | Source |
| ---- | ----------------- | ------- | ------ |
| `marked.min.js` | marked v12.0.2 | MIT | https://github.com/markedjs/marked — used by `markdown-previewer` |
| `qrcode.js` | qrcode-generator v1.4.4 (Kazuhiko Arase) | MIT | https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator — used by `qr-code-generator` |
| `md5.min.js` | blueimp-md5 v2.19.0 | MIT | https://github.com/blueimp/JavaScript-MD5 — used by `md5-hash-generator` |
